moments.text: Green title card: "Unclassified", footage from mission report 7750816, 12 July 22 2156Z.
Colour daytime camera looking down on a roadside building in the desert, crosshair on the road. Both sides of the picture are blurred and grey boxes cover parts.
A small round object, dark with a bright edge, appears upper right and crosses diagonally down-left past the crosshair, leaving at the bottom edge. About 1.7 s.
The camera slews away and pans quickly over desert ground: dark patches, a cluster of houses, then fields marked with rows.
The colours turn washed-out blue and white for about two seconds as the view sweeps over the rows.
Normal colours return; the camera keeps panning over open ground and small buildings until the clip ends.

notes: Left and right thirds of the frame are blurred (redaction), not black bars; usable picture is the centre strip.
